desc:
Shh... a GIANT baby is napping in the nursery!

Team up with up to 12 friends and survive a wild day in the giant baby’s house.

🍼 Nap Time — Play with the drum, the horn, the piano, the RC car... Too much noise and the baby wakes up!
👶 Nursery — The baby is awake and wants to play with YOU. Dodge it and stay alive!
🏃 Hallway — The door opens and the baby crawls after you, fast. Run!
🍪 Kitchen — Flip cookies to keep the baby busy and bounce on the jelly.
🌙 Living Room — Play ball, turn off the lights and sing a lullaby together. Get the baby back to sleep to win!

What you can do
• Swing around the room with your web (Q)
• Climb the furniture, ride the RC car and the dinosaur
• Pick up toys and throw them (E)
• Jump into a game that is already going, or start a new one with 4+ players
